intro.speaker: Morty
intro.text: It smells like a seafood buffet. And a police state.

intro.speaker: Morty
intro.text: Okay. Rick's last charge actually worked. Point, shoot, walk through. I can probably do this.

crystal.speaker: Morty
crystal.text: The Focus Crystal! The beam feels... pointier. It reaches farther now. And I think it goes through glass.

canister.speaker: Morty
canister.text: Shrimp Rick's Fluid Canister. Full charge. This thing could hit the far wall now.

canister.speaker: Morty
canister.text: It's humming. Mom said not to touch anything that hums. Sorry, Mom.

jammer.speaker: Morty
jammer.text: A big red button that says PORTAL JAMMER. That's why nobody portals out of here.

jammer.speaker: Morty
jammer.text: Someone left a Shrimp Police badge on the console. It's shiny. Finders keepers.

jammer.speaker: Morty
jammer.text: The gun says the chip is at... the Citadel? Okay. Jammer off. Sorry, jammer.

caught.speaker: Officer Krillson
caught.text: HALT. Your shell is not regulation.

caught.speaker: Officer Krillson
caught.text: Back to the start, citizen. Glory to the tank.

caught.speaker: Officer Krillson
caught.text: I saw nothing. Wait. No. I saw everything. HALT.

shotGuard.speaker: Officer Krillson
shotGuard.text: You PORTALED an officer? That is so many forms. HALT.

shrimpRick.speaker: Shrimp Rick
shrimpRick.text: You walked into my dimension and took my fluid. In this economy?

shrimpRick.speaker: Shrimp Rick
shrimpRick.text: I am the smartest shrimp in any ocean, Morty.

shrimpRick.speaker: Morty
shrimpRick.text: Why is it always shrimp? Why is it never something normal?

shrimpRick.speaker: Shrimp Rick
shrimpRick.text: Fine. You want a fight? I'll bring the sauce.

shrimpRick.speaker: Morty
shrimpRick.text: Nope! No fight! Jammer's off! Bye!

lines.speaker: Prawnsworth
lines.text: Psst. Not all of us like the parades.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Uh. Hi. I'm just here for some gun parts.

lines.speaker: Prawnsworth
lines.text: The canister is behind the glass. Officer Krillson walks the square all day.

lines.speaker: Prawnsworth
lines.text: And it's clamped. The clamp drinks from the plug on the far wall. Put the laser in a portal and the other end spits it out.

lines.speaker: Prawnsworth
lines.text: Your beam goes through glass now. Fire when his back is turned. Never shoot the guard. He takes it personally.

choices.text: I'll hurt Shrimp Rick's feelings for you.

lines.speaker: Prawnsworth
lines.text: Take the canister. Hurt his feelings. Please.

lines.speaker: Prawnsworth
lines.text: Nobody does. That's how we got parades.

lines.speaker: Prawnsworth
lines.text: Glory to the tank. That was sarcasm. Go.

plate.speaker: Morty
plate.text: The door's shut. There's a pressure plate on the other side of the goo. And a crate on this side. Of course there is.

plate.speaker: Morty
plate.text: Portals took me across. Maybe they take crates too. I push it in one, it comes out the other.

labSaw2.speaker: Morty
labSaw2.text: A laser on the back wall, shooting at nothing. A plug on the far wall. A cable from the plug to a clamp on the canister.

labSaw2.speaker: Morty
labSaw2.text: So the laser has to hit the plug. Through a portal. Somebody here loves puzzles and I hate that guy.

power.speaker: Morty
power.text: The clamp let go! Lasers go through portals. I'm basically a physicist now.

power.speaker: Morty
power.text: Don't tell Rick I said that.

labSaw3.speaker: Morty
labSaw3.text: A red laser right in front of the jammer. If I touch that, every shrimp in this dimension hears about it.

labSaw3.speaker: Morty
labSaw3.text: Something has to block it. Something big and square. Something like... the crate I walked past.

tripwire.speaker: Officer Krillson
tripwire.text: LASER GRID BREACH. Over the speakers, citizen: back to the start. That laser was very expensive.
